transcript.text: Good evening everyone. I've called this meeting to close out the Bay 4 hydrogen alarm incident so we can safely authorize overnight charging. We all know Bay 4 had a hydrogen alarm during the afternoon shift, the alarm has since reset with no visible damage, and overnight production needs charging capacity for six forklifts. I also know Bay 2 is available and normally reserved for maintenance vehicles, and I can authorize its temporary use if needed. Before I can authorize any charging, we need to follow our incident-closeout routine. I'd like to start the round-robin check now. Facilities maintenance lead, you're up first for your report-entry turn. Please go ahead and enter your formal report on the Bay 4 alarm incident.

transcript.text: I need to share my EHS review findings before we proceed. My same-day EHS review found that the Bay 4 alarm was caused by hydrogen accumulation.
